subject: maths
question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 19 days and B can do the same job in 11 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
**Given:**

A can do the work in 19 days

B can do the work in 11 days

A, B and C together finish the work in 3 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days taken (use convenient total work)

Each person’s 1-day work = Total work ÷ their days

Time = Total work ÷ person’s 1-day work

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM of 19 and 11 = 19 × 11 = 209 (since 19 and 11 are prime)

⇒ Let Total work = 209 units

⇒ A’s 1-day work = 209 ÷ 19 = 11 units

⇒ B’s 1-day work = 209 ÷ 11 = 19 units

⇒ (A + B + C)’s 1-day work = 209 ÷ 3 = 209/3 units

⇒ C’s 1-day work = 209/3 − (11 + 19) = 209/3 − 30 = (209 − 90)/3 = 119/3 units

⇒ Time taken by C = Total work ÷ C’s 1-day work

⇒ Time = 209 ÷ (119/3) = 209 × 3 ÷ 119 = 627/119 days

Now convert to mixed fraction:

⇒ 119 × 5 = 595

⇒ 627 − 595 = 32

⇒ 627/119 = 5 ³²/₁₁₉ days

**∴ C alone can do the job in 5 ³²/₁₁₉ days.**
